description: Three PreToolUse guards on Bash (pr-template-guard denies a gh pr create/edit whose body is missing a heading the repo's own PR template requires; skip-label-race-guard warns when a gh pr create applies the repo's review-skip label without --draft; merge-guard warns, never denies, when a command merges a pull request) and one opt-in PostToolUse hook on Bash (review-reply-postcondition requires a review reply that claims a fix to name a commit reachable from HEAD).
